name: UNISEM
recent: Unisem 在 2026 年 11 月 6 日公布截至 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，营收环比增长 6.6%，净利环比大增 210.1%，并宣布每股 1 仙的第一次中期股息。同期，大股东 Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (Diperbadankan) 以及 Tianshui Huatian Technology 系公司多次申报股权变动，执行董事 Francis Chia Mong Tet 也在公开市场增持股份。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度业绩，营收 6.077 亿令吉，净利 3,073 万令吉。
宣布 2026 财年第一次中期股息每股 1.0 仙。
执行董事 Francis Chia Mong Tet 在 11 月 3 日至 6 日期间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 大股东 Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (Diperbadankan) 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
Tianshui Huatian Technology 系公司（包括 Huatian Technology (Hongkong) 和 Huatian Technology (Malaysia)）多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度营收为 6.077 亿令吉，环比增长 6.6%，同比增长 27.9%；净利为 3,073 万令吉，环比增长 210.1%，同比增长 236.5%；净利率从上一季度的 1.7% 升至 5.1%。

recent_en: Unisem announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 6 November, with revenue up 6.6% QoQ and net profit up 210.1% QoQ, and declared a first interim dividend of 1 sen per share. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (Diperbadankan) and the Tianshui Huatian Technology group of companies filed multiple changes in shareholding, and Executive Director Francis Chia Mong Tet acquired shares in the open market.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM607.7 million and net profit of RM30.73 million.
Declared a first interim dividend of 1.0 sen per share for FY2026.
Executive Director Francis Chia Mong Tet acquired shares in the company multiple times between 3 and 6 November.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (Diperbadankan) filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November.
The Tianshui Huatian Technology group of companies (including Huatian Technology (Hongkong) and Huatian Technology (Malaysia)) filed multiple changes in shareholding.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was RM607.7 million, up 6.6% QoQ and 27.9% YoY; net profit was RM30.73 million, up 210.1% QoQ and 236.5% YoY; net margin rose to 5.1% from 1.7% in the previous quarter.
